title: How to retrieve or generate QuickBooks deep links without qzurl after modern reports update in June 2026
body_excerpt: I've seen come conflicting information about how deep links will be handled after the QuickBooks API update coming up next month. This article published March 30th states that [code] will no longer be supported (which is how we currently retrieve reporting deep links), yet this one just two weeks prior has [code] as a 'best practice' for the reports API. It's just weird they'd publish something then two week later announce it will not be supported. First article [code] mention: 7. Parameter qzurl not supported The qzurl parameter is not supported in v2. This is because the underlying architecture for the modern view is different and a deep link to a specific drilldown view cannot be formed. It instead is generated dynamically in the product. Second article conflicting information: 2. Leverage “Quick Zoom” (qzurl) If your app needs to allow users to “drill down” from a report summary into specific transactions, use the qzurl=true parameter. This returns a deep-link URL for each cell, enabling a seamless transition from your report to the specific data in the QuickBooks via drill down API calls. I haven't seen anything definitive on how we'll be able to generate these URLs post-update. Previously reporting deep link URLs could be created programmatically because they followed a predictable pattern. Now it seems reporting deep links will contain GUIDs which are created server-side
